The desktop gate on8b973e2d passed577/579 tests and exposed two additional native startup/pending-state defects. The first was stale source preparation starting a duplicate recomputation after another reader's job completed. The revised reservation path rechecks cached results/refusals/active jobs under the shared mutex after preparation, leaving host I/O outside that mutex. NativeReads5, conformance12, registry5 and binding3 tests passed25/25; NativeWindowFx1/1 retained its exact one-job assertion. Restoring only the old held implementation killed the new fifth regression by returning Pending(job2) after job1 completed. Correct bytes restored and Reads5/5 rerun green; strict coreJS compilation passed. Logs: /private/tmp/eyes4s-native-read-coalescing-focused.log, /private/tmp/eyes4s-native-coalescing-mutant.log, /private/tmp/eyes4s-native-coalescing-restored.log.

The second was a pending/disabled Save & run control retaining JavaFX's faded paint briefly after enabling, failing the existing4.5 contrast minimum. Scoped neutral tokens and opacity1 keep pending copy readable; the pure VM omits the pair-count segment while native counts are absent. Preflight5/5 passes JVM and JavaScript. A11yRender39/39 passes the new paint/copy; isolated actual Preparing controls in light/dark plus existing PreflightFX4/4 pass, with no backend allowed to hide the pending state. Token/type-scale and notice checks pass. Logs: /private/tmp/eyes4s-preflight-pending-contrast-qualified.log and /private/tmp/eyes4s-preflight-pending-final.log. No threshold, timeout or original numerical pin changed.

These are final candidate fixes for the integrated Studio and repository gates. The slice remains doing until those gates pass; automatic artifact binding, full G1/S3.7 and hosted qualification remain outside this bounded slice.
